hldContextSlice.frameworkSummary: Adopts a1 as the core architecture: an Intermediate Representation (IR) is the hard boundary between graph-derived content and LLM-narrated content, with a discriminated provenance flag on every IR node/edge/section so no runtime can blur the two. Cross-cutting failure/empty/truncation reporting is implemented once as a shared outcome envelope rather than per-story. a2's registry-enumeration idea is grafted in as an additive registration surface over the IR extractors (not a competing architecture), giving automatic tool/IPC/MCP parity and capability listing for one extra registry module. a3's delivery layer is adopted underneath: both the primary inline renderer and the D2/Graphviz subprocess fallback assemble into the identical single-file shell, which extends (rather than parallels) the existing loadMermaidCdnMeta and RenderedArtifactHtml primitives.

boundary.internal: The component/dependency extractor: walking module DEPENDS_ON/import edges into derived IrNodes/IrEdges, including nodes with no in- or out-edges so isolated modules are still emitted. The determinism guarantee that unchanged code re-extracts to an identical IR (compared via generatedAtRevision plus node/edge content, not re-narrated). Registering this extractor into sc2's DocTypeRegistry.

api.name: componentKey
api.signature: function componentKey(fileAbs: string, repoRoot: string, path: string | undefined): string

parameters.name: fileAbs
parameters.purpose: Absolute path of a file entity (Entity.file is absolute).

parameters.name: repoRoot
parameters.purpose: Registered repo root; combined with path to form the scope base.

parameters.name: path
parameters.purpose: Repo-relative scope prefix; when absent the base is the repo root.

returns.meaning: The component the file belongs to: the first path segment under join(repoRoot, path), or the bare relative path when the file sits directly in the scope base.

preconditions: fileAbs should lie under the scope base; if it does not, the raw relative remainder is used as the key (defensive).
postconditions: Deterministic pure function of its inputs (no I/O).

api.name: buildComponentDependencyIR
api.signature: function buildComponentDependencyIR(files: readonly FileEntityLite[], imports: readonly FileImportEdge[], repoRoot: string, path: string | undefined, revision: string, scopeDescription: string): DocumentIR

parameters.name: imports
parameters.purpose: Resolved file->file IMPORTS edges among the in-scope files.

parameters.name: revision
parameters.purpose: Pinned graph index revision written to generatedAtRevision (determinism, ac2).

parameters.name: scopeDescription
parameters.purpose: Human-readable scope label carried into the IR + the rendered title.

returns.meaning: A derived-only DocumentIR: one IrNode {kind:'component'} per distinct component, one deduped IrEdge {kind:'depends-on'} per cross-component import, narrated.sections=[].

preconditions: Pure: performs no graph reads; all data arrives via parameters.
postconditions: Intra-component and out-of-scope (unresolved-endpoint) imports produce no edge.
Every component that owns a file is emitted as a node even with no edge in or out (ac3).

api.name: makeExtract
api.signature: function makeExtract(reader: ComponentGraphReader): (input: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<DocGenOutcome<DocumentIR>>

parameters.name: reader
parameters.purpose: Injected graph read-seam (revision / filesInScope / importEdges); a fake in tests, the graph-backed reader in production.

returns.meaning: The bound extractor used in the DocTypeRegistration: parses scope, reads, and returns an outcome-wrapped IR.

errors.condition: input has no non-empty 'repo' string, or no files are found in scope.
reader.revision returns undefined (repo not finished indexing).

preconditions: reader is bound to the daemon graph layer (k2) or a test fake.
postconditions: On success returns ok(DocumentIR); never throws for the modeled failure cases — they are returned as typed outcomes (observability).

api.name: componentDependencyRegistration

parameters.name: reader
parameters.purpose: The graph read-seam bound into the registration's extract().

returns.meaning: The sc2 registration for docType 'component-dependency': capability summary + COMPONENT_DEPENDENCY_INPUT_SCHEMA + bound extract().

preconditions: Registered exactly once into the process-wide docgenRegistry alongside s1's type-structure registration.
postconditions: Enumerable via registry.list() -> automatic tool/IPC/MCP parity (k4).

api.name: documentIRToMermaid

parameters.name: ir
parameters.purpose: The derived IR to render; dispatch is on ir.docType.

returns.meaning: Mermaid source: a 'flowchart LR' with n<i>[label] boxes and 'from --> to' dependency arrows for docType 'component-dependency'; the existing 'classDiagram' for every other docType (type-structure output byte-unchanged).

preconditions: Node aliases (n0, n1, …) follow node order so entity ids never clash with Mermaid identifier syntax.
postconditions: Pure + deterministic; consumed unchanged by assembleShell to produce the sc3 RenderedDocumentShell.

dataModelChanges.details: s2 introduces the 'component-dependency' docType instance of sc1: derived.nodes carry kind='component' (label = componentKey), derived.edges carry kind='depends-on', narrated.sections is always empty. No structural change to the sc1 type itself — s2 only populates it. NOTE: sc1's HLD sketch listed a 'composes' edge kind; s2 does not emit it because the code graph records no composition edge — only IMPORTS-derived depends-on. This is a documented back-flow note, not a contract change.

Three s2-internal read-seam DTOs: FileEntityLite {id, file:absolute}, FileImportEdge {fromFileId, toFileId}, ComponentScope {repoRoot, path?}. They decouple the pure aggregation core from the daemon graph layer so the core is testable with fixtures.

interactionWithShared.howDetails: Produces a valid derived-only DocumentIR (narrated.sections=[]); node/edge kinds ('component','depends-on') fall within sc1's open kind strings. Populates generatedAtRevision from the reader for the ac2 determinism guarantee. Consumes the as-built structural derived/narrated partition (not the HLD's per-item provenance flag).

Plugs in via componentDependencyRegistration -> DocTypeRegistration and is register()'d as the 2nd doc type in src/docgen/index.ts, so it is enumerated by the single registry that drives tool/IPC/MCP surfaces (k4). No change to sc2.

Renders through the shared assembleShell unchanged; the only extension is documentIRToMermaid dispatching a flowchart body for this docType. The resulting RenderedDocumentShell (single self-contained offline HTML, inlined runtimes, SVG, zoom/pan) satisfies ac4 identically to s1.

errorCases.scenario: The repo is registered but has not finished indexing (no pinned revision).
errorCases.detection: reader.revision(repoRoot) resolves undefined because listRepos finds the repo with status !== 'ready'; makeExtract checks if (revision === undefined).
errorCases.response: Return DocGenOutcome 'source-not-ready' naming the repo; no IR is built and no partial document is written.
errorCases.userImpact: Caller is told the source isn't ready yet rather than getting an empty or wrong diagram; retriable once indexing completes.

errorCases.scenario: The scope resolves to zero in-scope files (empty repo, or a path prefix that matches nothing).
errorCases.detection: reader.filesInScope returns an empty array; makeExtract checks if (files.length === 0).
errorCases.response: Return DocGenOutcome 'empty-scope' naming the scope location; no nodes/edges fabricated.
errorCases.userImpact: Caller sees an explicit empty-scope reason instead of a blank diagram; fix by choosing a populated scope.

errorCases.scenario: The input carries no usable repo (missing or empty 'repo').
errorCases.detection: parseScope returns undefined because input['repo'] is not a non-empty string; makeExtract checks if (scope === undefined).
errorCases.response: Return DocGenOutcome 'empty-scope' with a 'no repo in scope input' message.
errorCases.userImpact: Caller is told the request was malformed rather than silently getting nothing.

errorCases.scenario: An in-scope file imports an external/unresolved module (bare package or unindexed path).
errorCases.detection: In the reader, entityIdsByU64s has no id for the neighbor u64, so the edge is skipped; in the pure core, componentByFileId.get(toFileId) is undefined for any endpoint not in scope.
errorCases.response: The import produces no depends-on edge (silently dropped as out-of-scope); the source component is still emitted as a node.
errorCases.userImpact: External dependencies never pollute an intra-repo module picture; nothing is invented (k11).

errorCases.scenario: The offline runtime asset is missing from the build output (e.g. copy-assets did not stage mermaid/svg-pan-zoom).
errorCases.detection: assembleShell's loadRuntime throws on readFile; caught and mapped.
errorCases.response: Return DocGenOutcome 'fallback-unavailable' naming the copy-assets ship step; never falls back to a CDN fetch (k5).
errorCases.userImpact: Caller gets an actionable build-config error instead of a document that would try to reach the network at view time.

edgeCases.input: A component that neither imports nor is imported by any other in-scope component (isolated module).
edgeCases.expected: It is emitted as an edge-less IrNode and rendered as a lone flowchart box (ac3) — never dropped.

edgeCases.input: Two or more files in component A each import files in component B.
edgeCases.expected: A single deduped A->B depends-on edge (dedupe by (from,to)), not one per file pair.

edgeCases.input: A file imports another file in the SAME component (intra-directory import).
edgeCases.expected: No edge (a===b is skipped); the component still appears as a node.

edgeCases.input: A file that sits directly in the scope base (e.g. src/config.ts under scope 'src').
edgeCases.expected: componentKey returns the bare filename ('config.ts') as its own single-file component node.

edgeCases.input: A component label containing Mermaid-hostile characters (quotes, angle brackets, newlines).
edgeCases.expected: escapeLabel strips quotes/backticks/newlines for the Mermaid alias label, and escapeHtml escapes the whole Mermaid source in the <pre>; the browser decodes it before Mermaid reads textContent, so the diagram still renders (ac4).

edgeCases.input: Whole-repo scope (no path) vs a drilled-in subtree (path prefix).
edgeCases.expected: The same extractor serves both; componentKey is computed relative to the scope base, so component granularity shifts to the next segment under the chosen path.

invariantsToPreserve.text: All structural content is derived deterministically from the indexed graph (file entities + IMPORTS edges); the LLM is never in the component/dependency path (narrated.sections stays empty).
Graph reads happen inside the daemon via the injected reader; the pure core performs no I/O, so callers reach the data only through the daemon (over IPC for CLI/MCP/IDE).
Every path and component shown is graph-backed — no raw file dump and no invented node or edge; out-of-scope/unresolved endpoints are dropped rather than guessed.

alternativesConsidered.name: File-import aggregation to directory-level components (AS BUILT)
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: A component = the first path segment under the scope base; a component A depends-on B iff any file in A has a file->file IMPORTS edge to a file in B.

alternativesConsidered.name: Module-entity-level components (use indexed 'module' entities directly)
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Skip directory aggregation; treat each indexed module/package entity as a node and read module->module dependency edges directly.
alternativesConsidered.reasonRejected: Fails ac1 (violates): the graph records no intra-repo module->module dependency edges — file->file IMPORTS is the substrate and repo->package DEPENDS_ON is external-only — so local components would draw an edgeless diagram or re-derive from file imports anyway. Would also require an amendment to the shipped contract.

alternativesConsidered.name: Per-file nodes with import edges (no aggregation)
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Every source file is its own node; every file->file IMPORTS edge is drawn directly, no directory collapse.
alternativesConsidered.reasonRejected: Violates ac4: at repo scope the file-level graph is far too large for a single legible SVG and immediately trips the s5 oversized-fallback path; answers 'which file imports which' (partial ac1) not the story's 'how do modules depend on one another'.
